source='''def transform(grid):
    # The horizontal 5 divider separates two panels; select the marker
    # color whose cell count changes most between the panels.
    divider = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 5 for v in row))
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, 5)})
    upper = grid[:divider]
    lower = grid[divider + 1:]
    def count(region, color):
        return sum(cell == color for row in region for cell in row)
    chosen = max(colors, key=lambda color: abs(count(upper, color) - count(lower, color)))
    return [[chosen, chosen], [chosen, chosen]]
'''
